label: Needs system (global)
description: Superordinate node: the person's organized system of necessities whose satisfaction is required for integrity, growth, and wellbeing

label: Physiological / existence
description: Homeostatic necessities: nutrition, rest, energy regulation

label: Safety / self-protection
description: Physical security, predictability, and order

label: Relatedness / belonging
description: Attachment, affiliation, intimacy, pair-bond and care lines
primary_source: Ryan & Deci (2000); Baumeister & Leary (1995)*; Kenrick et al. (2010)

label: Esteem / status
description: Social standing, prestige, and self-regard

label: Competence / achievement
description: Mastery, effectance, and achievement striving

label: Autonomy / self-determination
description: Volition, self-endorsement, self-congruent regulation

label: Meaning / growth
description: Purpose, coherence, self-actualization and growth orientation

label: Satisfaction channel
description: Aggregate state of need fulfillment across domains

label: Frustration channel
description: Aggregate state of active need thwarting; not the mere absence of satisfaction

label: Environmental supports/thwarts
description: Contexts that support or thwart needs; interface node to the Systems stratum

label: Wellbeing / flourishing
description: Vitality, intrinsic motivation, growth outcomes

label: Ill-being / defensiveness
description: Defensive functioning and psychopathology risk; interface node to the Disorder stratum (UDG)
primary_source: Vansteenkiste & Ryan (2013)*; Rettew & McKee-type risk channel

label: Motivation & goal layer
description: Interface node to the Motivation & Emotion stratum (Batch G): needs energize and direct goals

label: Personality layer
description: Interface node to the Personality stratum (UPerG): need strengths and satisfaction covary with traits

label: Dynamic prioritization
description: Deficit-, situation-, and life-stage-dependent salience ordering of needs (no fixed ladder)
primary_source: Kenrick et al. (2010); Montag et al. (2020)

label: Individual need strength
description: Acquired dispositional differences in need intensity (nAch, nAff, nPow)

label: Substitution / compensation
description: Compensatory pursuits when a need is blocked (need substitutes, consumer surrogates)

label: Homeostatic regulation
description: Hunger, thirst, thermoregulation

label: Rest / energy
description: Sleep and recovery

label: Physical safety
description: Protection from threat and harm

label: Predictability / order
description: Stable, forecastable environment (a basic need in Dweck's criteria)

label: Attachment / intimacy
description: Close bonds and intimacy

label: Belonging / affiliation
description: Group membership and affiliation (nAff)

label: Mating / care line
description: Mate acquisition, mate retention, parenting (evolutionary overlay)

label: Status / prestige
description: Standing in social hierarchies (nPow adjacency)

label: Self-esteem
description: Self-evaluative regard

label: Mastery / effectance
description: Experienced effectiveness in interaction

label: Achievement striving
description: Standard-of-excellence pursuit (nAch)

label: Volition
description: Acting with a sense of choice and self-endorsement

label: Self-congruence
description: Alignment of action with values and identity

label: Purpose / coherence
description: Life direction and intelligibility

label: Growth / self-actualization
description: Realization of capacities
